headline: The Bears' owner goes under
beats: The company behind the Brisbane Bears has gone into receivership, and the players have gone unpaid.

headline: Secret testing allegations
beats: An MP has alleged under parliamentary privilege that the league ran off-the-books drug tests and had players fake injuries to hide positives.
The league denies it.

headline: Homophobic slur bans
beats: The league has banned players at several clubs for homophobic slurs, for three to six matches.

title: A slur on the field
text: One of the club's players has been reported for a homophobic slur. The club can have him own it and take a shorter ban, or fight the charge.

choices.label: Have him own it

effects.why: The club owned a slur on the field

choices.result: The club accepts the charge and the shorter ban.

choices.label: Fight the charge
choices.result: The club fights the charge.

headline: The costume party
beats: An anonymous complaint about a GWS end-of-season costume party has ended in suspensions for six players and fines for seven.

title: End-of-season standards
text: After the costume-party bans, the board wants the coach to set rules for the players' end-of-season functions.

choices.label: Set strict rules

effects.why: You set strict rules for the players' functions

choices.result: You set the rules and tell the leaders to enforce them.

choices.label: Trust the leaders to run it
choices.result: You leave the functions to the leadership group.

headline: Three strikes scrapped
beats: The league and the players have agreed in principle to replace the three-strikes drugs policy with match bans for public use and regular hair testing.

headline: Sydney stand players down
beats: Sydney have stood five players down for the rest of the season, finals included, for breaching the club's standards.
